name: ranger-boots-banish-makes-your-champion-distant
notes: Ranger Boots: [Class Bonus] REST, banish: your champion becomes distant. The ability body was filed as a play-time effect and called BecomeDistant() without the champion (fatal); a field click routed through ActivateCard re-ran the On Enter draw and never banished the Boots.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Ranger Boots' '[Class Bonus] [REST], Banish Ranger Boots: Your champion becomes distant' was misfiled as a $cardActivatedAbilities body (a play-time effect) that called BecomeDistant($player) without the champion's mzID -- a fatal error -- and a field click was routed through ActivateCard, which re-ran the On Enter draw and never banished the Boots. Fix: registered as a real field activated ability (activateAbilityAbilities / prereq / count override) with the REST + banish cost in ActivatedAbilityCost(); the misfiled body is neutralized.
